# Provenance: SWE-agent marshmallow trajectories

These JSON traces were converted from public demonstration trajectories in
[`SWE-agent/SWE-agent`](https://github.com/SWE-agent/SWE-agent), which is
licensed under MIT. The trajectories exercise variants of the same accepted
solution for `marshmallow-code/marshmallow#1867`. Marshmallow is also an MIT
licensed upstream project; its notices continue to apply to excerpts carried
inside the trajectory observations. Copies are stored as
`LICENSE.SWE-agent.upstream` and `LICENSE.marshmallow.upstream`.

The exact SWE-agent and marshmallow source commits used for the original
conversion were not recorded. That missing pin limits byte-for-byte
provenance. Re-fetch and pin both upstream revisions before regenerating or
extending this research fixture.

These traces are source-tree research inputs. They are excluded from
TraceRazor wheels, source distributions, standalone archives, and runtime
container images. TraceRazor's project MIT license does not replace either
upstream notice.

The conversion recipe is documented in
[`docs/external_agent_audits.md`](../../../docs/external_agent_audits.md).
